use_case_summary: Surge Editor Labs builds an in-IDE copilot (code completion + multi-line suggestions). Primary requirement is low-latency streaming to avoid editor flicker: aggressive TTFT targets (50-120ms depending on network), low jitter, predictable tail behavior under bursty typing. They want model/version pinning for deterministic completions across releases and token-budget controls per suggestion to balance UX vs cost.
notes:
- Product: VSCode & JetBrains plugins + web editor. MVP: inline completions, followed by block suggestions and explain-on-hover.
- UX targets: TTFT 50-80ms median, 95th <= 120-150ms for local cloud region; jitter < 15ms ideal. Backend tail latency budget <200ms.
- Token budget tuning: prefer short streaming windows (8-16 token flush) for immediate UX while allowing speculative continuation. Typical suggestion budget 40-80 tokens; want to tune by language (Python 40, TS/JS 60).
- Backpressure: plugin must avoid UI jank if server delays; exploring client-side token budget fallback (show partial token + spine) and server push of delta tokens. SE notes: "If first token >150ms users perceive lag".
- Model/version pinning: need ability to pin minor model builds (e.g., v2.3-quant) per workspace and a rollout mechanism for new model weights. Canary across 5% of internal users desired.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to trade some token cost for sub-100ms TTFT but want Optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost.
- Security: SSO + SAML required, audit logs for completions, optional KMS integration for keys. Data residency: telemetry (latency traces) must be sharded to EU for EU customers.
- POC ask: 1-week dedicated pool with synthetic typing traces (10 concurrent devs, bursty typing), measure TTFT, jitter, p95/p99, token usage per suggestion. Provide config template for batching/window sizes and cache prefixes.
- Quote from eng lead (Eve Chan): "We can tolerate occasional longer completions, but the first token must feel instant. Anything over ~200ms and devs complain."
- Risk items: memory pressure in plugin during streaming, session affinity across model variants, graceful fallback when dedicated pool saturates.
technical_requirements: TTFT targets: median 50-80ms, p95 <= 120-150ms; jitter target <15ms; tail latency <200ms. Streaming window: initial flush 8 tokens, follow-ups 4 tokens; suggestion token budget tunable per language. Client must support streaming incremental tokens and partial rendering. Need model pinning API, canary rollouts, and automatic fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained.
